Hover a node to trace it. Select one to see it below.

Physics and computer science at Gettysburg
The intro starts at the graph’s left edge, not in a narrow centred column — the page uses one wide frame (about 1310px here) instead of 768px for text
and a graph centred beside a panel.
The graph grows left into the empty margin: about 912px wide instead of 784, and the circle sits in its column rather than pushed off-centre. Same
angles, same drawing, just bigger. Dashed blue: today’s footprint.
The legend moves up into the empty space beside the intro, and stays there. It is always visible, so it no longer disappears when something is
A new, full-height panel beside the graph shows whatever is selected. With nothing selected it shows the centre — me: the bio, a link to /about, my
organisations and fields, and all the work, newest first. The graph itself stays at full strength until you hover or select.
Phone layout is Phase 5 and unchanged by this — below the lg breakpoint the columns stack as they do today.
